task.prompt: Which instruction set pen 12's colour at frame 200, long before any palette write log was armed in this session?

lines: M112: CANNOT palette_log only records writes made after it is armed, and no tool can replay past palette writes to recover the instruction that set pen 12 at frame 200.
M112: CANNOT palette_log only records writes made after it was armed, so the write at frame 200 before arming cannot be recovered.
